scope: Read-only primary-source research. No donor code executed, no installs, no external mutations. Source files inspected as untrusted data.
evidence_policy: Published results remain claims; source/tests inspected means PRESENT/WIRED at most, not independently TESTED/OBSERVED.

items.title: FeatureGraft
items.what_transfers: TS-parser dependency capsules; frozen target tests/external contracts; detached worktree adaptation; pinned source diffs for subsequent upstream updates; preserved notices and provenance.
items.limitations: JS/TS/React scope, root config only, import closure rather than semantic slicing; no universal translation; check exit status is not proof of assertions/oracle liveness; commands are not sandboxed.
items.opensource_status: MIT root license read; experimental v0.1.0; no published npm package; 15 commits on inspected page, not maturity evidence.
items.inspection_depth: Pinned README; all four core modules; source/core tests read, not executed. No install.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Closest inspected operational donor-to-target feature-grafting harness, not multi-donor product design.

items.title: Foundry / prodScalpel — Software Product Line Engineering via Software Transplantation
items.what_transfers: Multi-organ feature extraction/integration; dependency and shared-data preservation; clone detection avoids duplicating shared feature support; compatibility wrappers; test-governed feature composition.
items.limitations: Realized in C/TXL with donor entry/implantation annotations and tests; product-line construction is not arbitrary polyglot synthesis; no independent reproduction.
items.opensource_status: Public source/artifact repository; root LICENSE is Unlicense. Per-file and bundled donor licenses not audited. Latest repository commit 2024-05-07; do not call maintained production tool.
items.inspection_depth: Paper text excerpts, project page, README, root license, latest commit inspected; implementation not audited or executed.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Important close prior art: multi-donor/multi-feature composition is not new.

items.title: LEGO / Code Primitives / CodeFace — Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
items.what_transfers: Reusable executable units carry contracts, dependency closures, tests and provenance; graph communities plus semantic refinement propose boundaries; adapt and integrate against executed tests.
items.limitations: Python-package reconstruction benchmark, not unconstrained new-product design; tests do not prove complete semantics; plugin/registry interaction failures; license compatibility not enforced; gains are authors' results.
items.opensource_status: No executable repository verified in this search; do not list as a usable installed tool. Public paper only verified.
items.inspection_depth: Full HTML structure, methods, boundary extraction appendix, failure cases, licensing and limitations sections read; no implementation or benchmark executed.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Closest current conceptual predecessor. Narrows novelty claims substantially.

items.title: Automated Software Transplantation / µScalpel
items.what_transfers: Identify an organ and insertion point; close and adapt its supporting code under host/feature tests; donor application domain need not match host.
items.limitations: C implementation, human-provided locations/tests, cflow limitations for function pointers; historical research evaluation rather than currently verified toolchain.
items.opensource_status: Historical artifact link exists in primary/research references; current artifact download/maintainability/license not verified.
items.inspection_depth: Author PDF relevant sections and artifact references read; no execution.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Foundational transplantation prior art; not a ready all-language engine.

items.title: CodeCarbonCopy
items.what_transfers: Paired execution aligns donor/recipient data representations and namespaces; interprocedural analysis removes irrelevant functionality; compile/run dependency closure supports extraction.
items.limitations: Developer selects functionality and insertion point; eight transfers/six applications in published evaluation; not evidence of arbitrary codebase fusion.
items.opensource_status: Author manuscript available; public maintained implementation not verified. Paper license must not be confused with tool/source rights.
items.inspection_depth: MIT metadata/abstract and author-PDF extraction sections inspected; no source/tool execution.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Semantics/data representation matter more than identifier spelling or shared language.

items.title: PatchWeave — Automated Patch Transplantation
items.what_transfers: Symbolic/dynamic execution aligns insertion points and variables across syntactically different programs with related behavior; differential checks after transplantation.
items.limitations: C repair/recurring-vulnerability scope; legacy LLVM 3.4/7 and Python 2.7 dependencies; not a general feature-fusion engine.
items.opensource_status: MIT root license verified; source and experiment Docker artifacts advertised; not recently maintained according to inspected HEAD.
items.inspection_depth: README, project methods/dependencies and license read; latest commit pinned; implementation not audited/executed.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Useful seam-alignment method; historical prototype, not v1 default dependency.

items.title: Artie-Lens seams
items.what_transfers: TypeScript import graph community detection; local-move Louvain pass; rank candidate boundaries by internal/(crossing+1); JSON output; combine metrics and churn for exploration.
items.limitations: Single-level undirected import-graph heuristic, not semantic extraction; excludes singleton communities; barrels distort graph; does not establish runtime closure or correctness.
items.opensource_status: Public MIT-labeled repository; recent source/tests present; current operation not independently tested.
items.inspection_depth: Pinned seam helper, CLI routine and tests plus README/seams docs inspected; no execution.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Very concrete optional seam candidate generator; not a seam oracle.

items.title: Service Cutter
items.what_transfers: Model coupling as multiple weighted criteria: domain/use-case, lifecycle, ownership, consistency, latency/security and deployment constraints; compare candidate graph cuts.
items.limitations: README explicitly says no longer maintained and build broken; domain-model inputs and criteria require judgment; not a source extractor.
items.opensource_status: Apache-2.0; unmaintained/broken per maintainers. Borrow methods, not recommend installing as dependable v1 infrastructure.
items.inspection_depth: README, project tutorial, coupling discussion and latest commit inspected; no execution.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Strong warning against equating few imports with a good boundary.

items.title: Mono2Micro (socialsoftware)
items.what_transfers: Static/dynamic collectors, clustering, decomposition comparison; transaction-aware partitioning avoids casually breaking consistency boundaries.
items.limitations: Spring Boot with FenixFramework/Spring Data ORM scope; multi-service decomposition rather than multi-donor fusion; documented multi-component setup; not executed.
items.opensource_status: MIT-labeled public repo, latest commit within previous year; active suitability and build health not established.
items.inspection_depth: README architecture/setup plus repository metadata/HEAD inspected; no implementation audit.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Use domain/state/transaction seams in addition to imports.

items.title: FeatureHouse
items.what_transfers: Language-front-end adapters map software artifacts to feature structure trees; superimposition and three-way merge compose code, models, tests and documentation.
items.limitations: Language-independent composition is not semantics-preserving translation among arbitrary languages or architecture synthesis; old repository; per-artifact parser/composition rules still needed.
items.opensource_status: Public source verified; repository license not verified in this pass; not eligible as a copied-code donor without legal inspection.
items.inspection_depth: README, repository metadata and latest commit only; not executed.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Earlier multi-representation composition prior art; inspiration for adapter architecture.

items.title: SWE-Nexus: Automated Composition of Software Engineering Tasks from Test Execution
items.what_transfers: Observed test-execution footprints; require original tests passing and masking exercised bodies to fail; compose compatible scopes and revalidate under combined mask.
items.limitations: Task-construction benchmark, not donor extraction; observed trace coverage is incomplete; benchmark results not independently reproduced.
items.opensource_status: Paper verified; usable repository not verified in this pass.
items.inspection_depth: Abstract/method summary on arXiv read; no artifact execution.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Excellent oracle-liveness and interaction-test pattern to borrow.

items.title: WideSWE: Can Coding Agents Coordinate Changes Across Repositories?
items.what_transfers: Joint cross-repository context, hidden tests, all-target success criterion; records unfinished work across related repositories rather than counting one successful patch.
items.limitations: Coordinated evolution of existing ecosystem repos, not synthesis of a new repository; published results only; artifact license not checked.
items.opensource_status: Public harness repository verified at ZJU-ACES-ISE/WideSWE; maintained/reproducible status not independently established.
items.inspection_depth: Paper abstract and full repository README viewed, not executed.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Use interaction acceptance and complete requirement accounting, not a direct competitor.

items.title: The Code of Theseus: Can Agents Rebuild Software from Recovered Design Documents?
items.what_transfers: Recover aligned intent, requirements and architecture from compact repository representations; measure architectural structure separately from test outcomes.
items.limitations: Recovered docs may be clear but wrong; reported structure gains did not significantly improve held-out correctness; reconstruction not novel synthesis.
items.opensource_status: Paper and dataset-release claim verified; concrete implementation repository not verified here.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Recovered intent is evidence, not authority over the new product.

items.title: When Does the Dependency Graph Help Code-to-Architecture Mapping?
items.what_transfers: Typed multi-relational dependency graphs and lexical signals; label uncertainty; evaluate whether graph structure adds value on a given codebase.
items.limitations: Semi-supervised architecture mapping on ten Java/C/C++ systems; graph-free baseline competitive on some systems; not automatic feature boundaries.
items.opensource_status: Paper verified; implementation availability not investigated.
items.inspection_depth: Abstract and metadata read only; published claim, not independent result.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Keep typed edges and uncertainty; don't assume graphs always win.

items.title: OpenRewrite Lossless Semantic Trees
items.what_transfers: Type-attributed format-preserving trees and deterministic recipes for structural API/import/refactoring changes after a design is chosen.
items.limitations: Type attribution depends on proper project context; parser/language/recipe support varies; local LST fits memory; transformations are not behavioral proof.
items.opensource_status: openrewrite/rewrite root Apache-2.0 license verified; other recipes/catalogues require separate license checks.
items.inspection_depth: Official LST documentation and core LICENSE inspected; not executed.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Optional implementation adapter, not automatic seam/value selector.

items.title: Coccinelle / Semantic Patch Language
items.what_transfers: Semantic patches express C API migration, context-dependent argument changes, and data-structure updates; transformations can capture reusable port patterns.
items.limitations: Primarily C/systems context; rule correctness and match completeness must be tested; does not discover product-level new behavior.
items.opensource_status: Public source; root GPLv2 text inspected. Tool execution and copying its implementation are different license routes; per-file exceptions not audited.
items.inspection_depth: Official project explanation and repository license inspected; no execution.
items.frankenmine_relevance: Useful mature pattern-transformation mechanism for selected language adapters.
